truth_label: retrospective gate-only allocator replacement on previously observed market outcomes
purpose: Determine whether replacing the Alpha2 pre-birth allocator changes the selected frozen factor and improves performance under the exact S&P 500 common operating point.

new_allocator.round_budget: alpha * log(2) * (1/log(r+1) - 1/log(r+2)) for r starting at 1
new_allocator.prebirth_score: selected-parent skill reliability available before the round evidence
new_allocator.operationalization_note: All local candidates in one native Alpha2 round share the same selected parent and therefore the same prebirth score. Softmax is consequently uniform within each round; this replay tests the long-tail round reserve plus exploration floor, not candidate-specific reliability ranking.
new_allocator.selection_rule: Select maximum max_log_e among candidates crossing their immutable alpha threshold; if none crosses, select maximum max_log_e among all candidates; candidate_id ascending breaks ties.

primary_comparison: explore_exploit_allocator minus current_allocator within matched evidence-credit seeds at 10 bps
multiplicity: Holm across the complete four-endpoint primary family

uncertainty.summary_interval: two-sided normal 95% interval over ten eligible frozen proposer seeds

claim_limits: This is a retrospective version comparison because the locked market outcomes were previously observed.
The replay isolates the gate and final-selection effect; the current operationalization does not feed certification decisions into proposer or skill updates.
Real-market outcomes cannot establish FWER because factor truth is unknown.
No allocator parameter may be changed after viewing this experiment.
